checklists.nombre: Revisión de la mañana de Marco Aurelio
checklists.contexto: Para prepararte al día y a los tratos difíciles.

items.texto: Anticipá a la gente difícil antes de salir
items.cita: Betimes in the morning say to thyself, This day I shalt have to do with an idle curious man, with an unthankful man, a railer, a crafty, false, or an

items.texto: Podés retirarte dentro de vos cuando quieras
items.cita: it is in thy power to retire into thyself, and to be at rest, and free from all businesses.

items.texto: Dondequiera que vivas, podés vivir bien
items.cita: there it is in thy power to live well and happy. But thou mayest live at the Court, there then

items.texto: Que tu opinión no contradiga la naturaleza ni la razón
items.cita: that thy opinion do not beget in thy understanding anything contrary to either nature, or the proper constitution of a rational creature. The end
